explication: Hydra is an Electron gaming platform: players discover games, manage a library, download and install titles, then use game, social, achievement, and cloud-save features. The main process coordinates desktop services; React provides the standard and controller-oriented interfaces, while Rust supplies native capabilities including cloud-save and torrent code. The README establishes the product capabilities; sampled imports and calls support only some internal links, so unsampled subsystem connections are omitted or marked unverified.
